parsed.summary: PLAN-B74 is thoroughly specified, robustly mitigating look-ahead bias (strict EOD bar confirmation, in-sample factor selection, verify_impl truncation checks), statistical pitfalls (global Benjamini-Hochberg across R1-R6, monthly block bootstrap for overlapping multi-horizon returns, sub-period sign consistency, sample size and Wilson CIs), and operational fragility (tiered data fallbacks, per-source status monitoring, strict LLM token caps, price hallucination verification, and fallback to cached roundtable). UX optimizations cleanly address the 10-second summary bottleneck and the date formatting/broadth scaling bug in market_daily.

findings.issue: During strong momentum or gap-open environments, candidate levels within the ±6% (short-term) or ±15% (swing) windows might yield fewer than 3 support or resistance bands (e.g., in uncharted all-time highs above 46,000 where historical resistance is sparse).
findings.suggestion: Ensure the level extraction and push formatter gracefully handle lists with fewer than 3 items (or 0 overhead resistance levels at all-time highs), substituting fallback Fibonacci extensions/round-thousand psychological marks to avoid index out-of-range errors or empty strings in pre-market push messages.

findings.issue: Consecutive foreign buying/selling day streaks ('連買／連賣天數') can be distorted around long market closures (e.g., 7–10 day Lunar New Year break) if calendar days rather than consecutive trading-bar dates are used.
findings.suggestion: Confirm in `wave/chips.py` that consecutive streak counters operate strictly on consecutive trading-bar rows sorted by trading date, ignoring calendar day gaps between sessions.

parsed.coverage: Reviewed look-ahead controls in ZigZag confirmation and foreign index alignment, statistical rigor of pre-registered backtests (R1–R6, block bootstrap, global BH, Wilson intervals), Elliott wave symmetry and rule enforcement, multi-tier data source fallbacks (TWSE MI_5MINS_HIST, TAIFEX, FinMind), LLM token limits and price hallucination guards, database migration for breadth, and test suites.
parsed.limitations: Review is based on PLAN-B74.md architectural and statistical specifications without live runtime execution of the code or Fly environment secrets.
